title: SSC CGL Tier-1 Full Mock Test 08 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CGL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CGL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Needle : Stitch :: Pen : ?
questions.explanation: Needle is used to stitch; pen is used to write.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Court : Justice :: Hospital : ?
questions.explanation: Court is associated with justice; hospital with treatment.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the next term: 7, 15, 31, 63, 127, ?
questions.explanation: Each term is previous×2 +1: 127×2+1=255.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If BRAIN is coded as CSBJO, how is HEART coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: H→I, E→F, A→B, R→S, T→U.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a code, MANGO is written as NZOHP. How is APPLE written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: A→B, P→Q, P→Q, L→M, E→F.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, Ravi said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to Ravi?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son is Ravi's father; his daughter is Ravi's sister.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: D is A's maternal grandfather, so A is D's granddaughter.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 10 m north, then 6 m east, then 10 m south. How far is he from the start?
questions.explanation: North and south cancel; remaining 6 m east.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: From point P, Q is 8 km east. From Q, R is 6 km north. Distance PR is:
questions.explanation: Right triangle 8-6-10.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All books are papers. Some papers are pens. Conclusions: I. Some books are pens. II. Some pens are papers.
questions.explanation: I does not necessarily follow; II follows from 'some papers are pens'.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All cats are animals. All animals are living. Conclusions: I. All cats are living. II. Some living are cats.
questions.explanation: Both conclusions follow from the chain.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: Triangle, Square, Rectangle, Circle
questions.explanation: Circle has no sides; others are polygons.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: Mercury, Venus, Mars, Moon
questions.explanation: Moon is a satellite, others are planets.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A,B,C,D,E sit in a row. A is to the left of B but right of C. D is to the right of B. E is between B and D. Who is in the middle?
questions.explanation: Order: C A B E D. Middle is B.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the 15th of a month is Thursday, what day is the 3rd of the same month?
questions.explanation: 3rd is 12 days before 15th. 12 = 1 week + 5 days, so Thursday minus 5 = Saturday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents: Doctors, Women, Mothers?
questions.explanation: Women, doctors and mothers overlap partially; intersecting circles best represent the relation.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If a clock shows 3:45, the mirror image time is closest to:
questions.explanation: Mirror of h:m is 11:60 minus time → 11:60-3:45=8:15.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once along the diagonal and a hole is punched at the centre of the folded triangle. How many holes when unfolded?
questions.explanation: One fold along diagonal yields 2 layers; one punch gives 2 holes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, Ravi is 11th from the left and Seema is 31st from the right. How many students are between them?
questions.explanation: Ravi position 11; Seema from left = 40-31+1=10. Seema is 10th, Ravi 11th, so no one between if order left-to-right Seema then Ravi. Between = 0.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 1 January 2024 was Monday, what day was 1 March 2024?
questions.explanation: Jan 31 days + Feb 29 (leap) = 60 days = 8 weeks +4 → Monday+4=Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All that glitters is not gold. Conclusion: I. Gold does not glitter. II. Some glittering things are not gold.
questions.explanation: The proverb means some glittering things are not gold.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: BDF, CFI, DHL, ?
questions.explanation: First +1, second +2,+3 pattern: B C D E; D F H J; F I L O → EJO.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 64 small cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: 4×4×4 cube; edges except corners: 12 edges × 2 = 24.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: Battle of Plassey, 23 June 1757, between British and Siraj-ud-Daulah.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who founded the Slave Dynasty in India?
questions.explanation: Qutb-ud-din Aibak founded the Mamluk/Slave Dynasty in 1206.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the amendment procedure?
questions.explanation: Article 368 provides the power and procedure to amend the Constitution.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The idea of the Concurrent List in the Indian Constitution is borrowed from:
questions.explanation: Concurrent List is taken from the Australian Constitution.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which is the longest river entirely flowing in India?
questions.explanation: Ganga originates in India but also flows through Bangladesh; Godavari is the longest river wholly in India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram — not Odisha.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who is called the Father of Indian Green Revolution?
questions.explanation: M.S. Swaminathan is regarded as the Father of the Green Revolution in India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Repo rate is the rate at which:
questions.explanation: Repo is the rate at which RBI lends short-term funds to banks against securities.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The SI unit of electric charge is:
questions.explanation: Electric charge is measured in coulomb (C).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which gas is mainly responsible for the greenhouse effect on Earth?
questions.explanation: CO2 is the principal long-lived greenhouse gas from human activity.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Vitamin D deficiency causes:
questions.explanation: Rickets in children is due to Vitamin D deficiency.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who wrote the book 'Discovery of India'?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru wrote The Discovery of India during imprisonment (1942–46).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The headquarters of ISRO is located at:
questions.explanation: ISRO headquarters is in Bengaluru.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: G20 Presidency of India was held in which year?
questions.explanation: India held the G20 Presidency in 2023; summit in New Delhi.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The first Indian to win a Nobel Prize was:
questions.explanation: Tagore won Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The term 'LBW' is associated with which sport?
questions.explanation: Leg Before Wicket is a mode of dismissal in cricket.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Bihu is the folk dance of which state?
questions.explanation: Bihu is the traditional dance and festival of Assam.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Chipko Movement was related to:
questions.explanation: Chipko (1970s, Uttarakhand) involved hugging trees to prevent felling.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The capital of the Mauryan Empire was:
questions.explanation: Pataliputra (modern Patna) was the Mauryan capital.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who built the Qutub Minar?
options: Started by Qutb-ud-din Aibak, completed by Iltutmish
questions.explanation: Aibak started Qutub Minar; Iltutmish completed it.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place in:
questions.explanation: 13 April 1919 at Amritsar.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: How many Fundamental Duties are there in the Indian Constitution at present?
questions.explanation: Originally 10; 11th added by 86th Amendment (education of children).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which planet is known as the Morning Star?
questions.explanation: Venus appears bright near sunrise/sunset and is called Morning/Evening Star.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: pH of a neutral solution at 25°C is:
questions.explanation: Neutral water has pH 7 at 25°C.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: GST in India was implemented from:
questions.explanation: GST came into force on 1 July 2017.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Synonym of ABANDON:
questions.explanation: Abandon means to leave/forsake.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Synonym of BRIEF:
questions.explanation: Brief means short or concise.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of GENEROUS:
questions.explanation: Generous opposite is stingy/miserly.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of EXPAND:
questions.explanation: Expand opposite is contract/shrink.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'Bite the bullet' means:
questions.explanation: It means to face a difficult situation with courage.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'Spill the beans' means:
questions.explanation: To disclose confidential information.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part with error: The committee / have decided / to postpone / the meeting.
questions.explanation: Committee is collective singular here → has decided.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Neither of the two boys / were present / in the class / yesterday.
questions.explanation: Neither takes singular verb: was present.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is senior ___ me by two years.
questions.explanation: Senior/junior/prefer take 'to', not 'than'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She has been living here ___ 2018.
questions.explanation: Point of time → since.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who loves books:
questions.explanation: Bibliophile is a book lover.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A speech made without preparation:
questions.explanation: Extempore/impromptu speech.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change to passive: They will complete the work tomorrow.
options: The work will be completed by them tomorrow.
The work is completed by them tomorrow.
The work was completed by them tomorrow.
The work has been completed by them tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + V3.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, 'I am unwell.' Indirect form:
options: He said that he was unwell.
He said that I am unwell.
He said that he is unwell.
He told that he was unwell.
questions.explanation: Present becomes past in indirect speech.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correct article: He is ___ honest man.
questions.explanation: Honest begins with a vowel sound.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelled word:
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is embarrass.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Arrange: P: it rained heavily Q: the match was cancelled R: because S: last night
questions.explanation: The match was cancelled because it rained heavily last night → Q R P S.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Tone of a passage that criticises government policy is usually:
questions.explanation: Criticism implies a critical tone.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The book is ___ the table.
questions.explanation: On the table is standard.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Work hard ___ you should fail.
questions.explanation: Lest is followed by should.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'In a nutshell' can be replaced by:
questions.explanation: In a nutshell means briefly.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The comparative of 'good' is:
questions.explanation: good-better-best.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: By next year she ___ her degree.
questions.explanation: Future perfect for action finished by a future time.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Meaning of 'Inevitable':
questions.explanation: Inevitable means unavoidable.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He suggested me to wait. Improved:
options: He suggested that I should wait.
questions.explanation: Suggest is not followed by object + to-infinitive; use that-clause.
